scripts.build:prod: node node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng.js build --configuration production --base-href /loopkeeper/ && node scripts/fix-static-blocks.cjs && node scripts/fix-index-css.cjs
scripts.build:native: node node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng.js build --configuration production,native --base-href / && node scripts/fix-static-blocks.cjs && node scripts/fix-index-css.cjs && npx cap sync android

_resolutionsNote: 2026-08-26 DEPENDENCY REPAIR: nx/@nx/@nrwl 19.8.15 was a partially-published release — @nrwl/tao and @nrwl/devkit 19.8.15 were never uploaded to the registry — which hard-broke fresh `yarn install` (npm only 'worked' because its stale lockfile predated the broken release). Pinning the whole family to the last complete release (19.8.14). Do not remove unless you re-verify @nrwl/* publishes.
_ajvNote: 2026-08-26 DEPENDENCY REPAIR: ajv is a deliberate DIRECT devDependency. @angular-devkit/core pins ajv 8.16.0 exactly, but eslint's ajv ^6.12.4 won the yarn-1 root hoist — the Angular CLI schema registry then crashed with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading code)' inside ajv-formats/addFormats. Declaring ajv 8.16.0 directly forces it to win the root slot; ajv@6 nests under eslint. Do not remove or downgrade.
